reason: FABLE set 1 Exercise 11-2: replace all nine examples with verified historical dates, superseding the earlier three-card birthday revision.

verifiedFacts.note: German armistice; do not claim the legal end of the entire war.
Liberation in 1945, not the establishment of the ROK government in 1948.
Official archive gives the uprising period as May 18–27, 1980.
Describe the protests that day; earlier protests also formed part of the revolution.
Landing at 20:17 UTC July 20, distinct from the first step on July 21 UTC.
